title: Diagonal Walking
statementMd:
Mikhail walks on a 2D plane. He can go either up or right. You are given a sequence of Mikhail's moves. He thinks that this sequence is too long and he wants to make it as short as possible.

In the given sequence moving up is described by character `U` and moving right is described by character `R`. Mikhail can replace any pair of consecutive moves `RU` or `UR` with a diagonal move (described as character `D`). After that, he can go on and do some other replacements, until there is no pair of consecutive moves `RU` or `UR` left.

Your problem is to print the minimum possible length of the sequence of moves after the replacements.

## Input

The first line of the input contains one integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the length of the sequence. The second line contains the sequence consisting of $*n*$ characters `U` and `R`.

## Output

Print the minimum possible length of the sequence of moves after all replacements are done.

## Note

In the first test the shortened sequence of moves may be `DUD` (its length is $3$).

In the second test the shortened sequence of moves can be `UUDRRRDUDDUUU` (its length is $13$).
statementZhMd:
Mikhail 在二维平面上行走。他可以向上或向右移动。现在给定 Mikhail 的移动序列。他认为这个序列太长了，希望尽可能缩短它。

在给定的序列中，向上移动用字符 `U` 表示，向右移动用字符 `R` 表示。Mikhail 可以将任意一对连续移动 `RU` 或 `UR` 替换为一次对角线移动（用字符 `D` 表示）。之后，他还可以继续进行其他替换，直到不存在连续的 `RU` 或 `UR` 为止。

你的任务是输出完成替换后，移动序列可能达到的最小长度。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$），表示序列的长度。第二行包含一个由 $*n*$ 个字符 `U` 和 `R` 组成的序列。

## 输出格式

输出完成所有替换后，移动序列可能达到的最小长度。

## 说明

在第一个测试中，缩短后的移动序列可以是 `DUD`（其长度为 $3$）。

在第二个测试中，缩短后的移动序列可以是 `UUDRRRDUDDUUU`（其长度为 $13$）。
